Yes. The 2023 study found that SMEs already employing AI-skilled staff were more likely to hire additional AI staff than other SMEs. This suggests increasing AI specialisation among AI-based small businesses.[1]

The study defined SMEs as companies with fewer than 200 staff.[2] The finding should be treated cautiously: existing AI skills were identified from potentially incomplete staff samples, limited to around 1,000 records per company.[3]

citations.quote: Further, SMEs with existing AI-staff are more likely to hire more AI-staff than other SMEs.
Together this suggests increased AI specialisation by AI-based SMEs
